consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1973-09-12 show at William and Mary College was a solid performance, though it may not have reached the heights of the previous night. The inclusion of saxophone added a unique flavor to the jams, and many enjoyed the intimate feel of the music.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 20 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many found enjoyable moments and praised specific songs, there were also criticisms regarding the overall energy and performance compared to other shows from the same era.
